name: Physics
description: Mechanics, thermodynamics, waves, optics, electricity & modern physics for NEB +2 Science.
overview: NEB Physics (Class 12) is a theoretical + numerical heavy subject worth 75 marks in theory and 25 in practical. Mastering derivations, laws and problem-solving with unit-wise question banks is essential for a strong +2 GPA and medical/engineering entrance preparation.

name: Chemistry
description: Physical, inorganic and organic chemistry with complete NEB syllabus coverage for +2 Science.
overview: NEB Chemistry is a 75-mark theory subject (plus practicals) covering physical chemistry fundamentals, inorganic reactions and full organic chemistry.

name: Biology
description: Botany and zoology for NEB +2 Science — full syllabus, labeled diagrams and MCQs for medical entrance.
overview: NEB Biology combines botany and zoology into a 75-mark theory subject. Diagram-based answers, classification, anatomy and physiology dominate the paper.

name: Mathematics
description: NEB grade 12 mathematics — calculus, algebra, conics, vectors and statistics with full solutions.
overview: NEB Mathematics (Class 12) is a rigorous 75-mark subject for Science and Management streams.

name: English
description: Reading comprehension, grammar, vocabulary and essay writing for the NEB English paper.
overview: NEB English (Class 12) evaluates reading comprehension, grammar in context, vocabulary, writing and creative skills.

name: Computer Science
description: Computer fundamentals, programming and web development for NEB Computer Science.
overview: NEB Computer Science introduces computer fundamentals, programming concepts and web development.

name: Accountancy
description: Financial accounting, journal, ledger, trial balance and final accounts for NEB Management.
overview: Accountancy is the highest-scoring subject in NEB Management (100 marks including practical).

name: Economics
description: Micro & macro economics with Nepali context — supply, demand, market structures and development.
overview: NEB Economics covers microeconomic foundations, macroeconomics, and Nepali development context.

name: Business Studies
description: Principles of management, business environment and entrepreneurship for NEB Management.
overview: NEB Business Studies covers management principles, functions, business environment, and entrepreneurship.

name: Nepali
description: व्याकरण, पाठ बुझाइ र रचना — पूर्णाङ्क प्राप्त गर्न सम्पूर्ण सामग्री।
overview: NEB नेपाली विषयले व्याकरण, अपठित पाठ, कथा/निबन्ध लेखन र आधुनिक साहित्यको ज्ञान जाँच्छ।

name: Social Studies
description: History, civics, geography and economics of Nepal — the NEB paper that rewards structured answers.
overview: NEB Social Studies covers our nation's history, constitutional development, civics, geography and current affairs.

name: Diploma in Civil Engineering
description: CTEVT 3-year diploma in civil engineering — surveying, drawing and construction technology.
overview: The CTEVT Diploma in Civil Engineering is a 3-year, 6-semester program producing mid-level engineering technicians.

name: Diploma in Nursing
description: PCL Nursing — anatomy, pharmacology, medical-surgical nursing and midwifery for CTEVT nursing.
overview: CTEVT Proficiency Certificate Level (PCL) Nursing is a 3-year diploma creating registered nurses.

name: Digital Logic
description: Boolean algebra, logic gates, combinational and sequential circuits for BSc CSIT Semester 1.
overview: Digital Logic introduces the fundamentals of digital systems including number systems, Boolean algebra, logic gates, combinational circuits, sequential circuits and state machines. Essential foundation for computer architecture.

name: Physics I
description: Mechanics, waves and thermodynamics fundamentals for BSc CSIT Semester 1.
overview: Physics I covers classical mechanics, oscillations, waves and thermal physics. Provides the mathematical and conceptual foundation for understanding physical systems.

name: Calculus I
description: Limits, derivatives, integrals and differential equations for BSc CSIT Semester 1.
overview: Calculus I covers limits, continuity, differentiation, integration and elementary differential equations. Provides mathematical foundation for algorithm analysis and modeling.

name: English I
description: Technical writing, comprehension and communication skills for BSc CSIT Semester 1.
overview: English I develops academic reading, writing and presentation skills. Covers technical writing, comprehension, grammar and communication for CS students.

name: C Programming
description: Programming fundamentals in C — variables, control structures, functions, pointers and files.
overview: C Programming introduces procedural programming concepts. Covers variables, data types, control structures, functions, arrays, pointers, structures and file handling. Builds strong programming foundation.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Arrays, linked lists, trees, graphs, sorting and searching algorithms for BSc CSIT Semester 2.
overview: Data Structures & Algorithms covers fundamental data structures (arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs) and algorithm analysis. Core subject for technical interviews and competitive programming.

name: Microprocessor
description: 8085/8086 microprocessor architecture, assembly language programming and interfacing.
overview: Microprocessor covers 8085 and 8086 architecture, assembly language programming, interrupts and interfacing. Understanding hardware-software interface at the lowest level.

name: Mathematics III
description: Linear algebra, probability and statistics for BSc CSIT Semester 2.
overview: Mathematics III covers linear algebra (matrices, eigenvalues), probability theory and statistical methods. Essential for machine learning and data analysis foundations.

name: Computer Architecture
description: CPU design, memory hierarchy, pipelining and I/O organization for BSc CSIT Semester 2.
overview: Computer Architecture covers CPU organization, instruction sets, memory hierarchy, pipelining, parallel processing and I/O systems. Understanding how computers execute programs efficiently.

name: Theory of Computation
description: Automata theory, formal languages, computability and complexity for BSc CSIT Semester 3.
overview: Theory of Computation covers finite automata, context-free grammars, pushdown automata, Turing machines, computability and computational complexity. Theoretical foundation of computer science.

name: Operating Systems
description: Process management, memory management, file systems and OS design for BSc CSIT Semester 3.
overview: Operating Systems covers process management, CPU scheduling, memory management, file systems, I/O systems, protection and security. Understanding how software controls hardware resources.

name: Database Management Systems
description: Relational databases, SQL, normalization, transactions and NoSQL for BSc CSIT Semester 3.
overview: DBMS covers relational model, SQL, normalization, transaction management, concurrency control and recovery. Essential for building data-driven applications.

name: Computer Networks
description: OSI/TCP-IP models, routing, transport protocols and network security for BSc CSIT Semester 3.
overview: Computer Networks covers network architectures, protocols, routing algorithms, transport layer protocols and network security. Understanding how systems communicate over networks.

name: Numerical Methods
description: Root finding, interpolation, numerical integration and differential equations for BSc CSIT Semester 3.
overview: Numerical Methods covers algorithms for solving mathematical problems numerically. Essential for scientific computing, simulation and data analysis.

name: Software Engineering
description: Software development lifecycle, agile methods, testing and project management for BSc CSIT Semester 4.
overview: Software Engineering covers SDLC models, requirement analysis, design patterns, testing methodologies, project management and quality assurance. Professional software development practices.

name: Algorithm Design
description: Divide and conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming and NP-completeness for BSc CSIT Semester 4.
overview: Algorithm Design covers advanced algorithmic paradigms including divide-and-conquer, greedy algorithms, dynamic programming, graph algorithms and computational complexity. Core for competitive programming.

name: Web Technology
description: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, server-side programming and web frameworks for BSc CSIT Semester 4.
overview: Web Technology covers modern web development including HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, server-side programming, databases and web frameworks. Building full-stack web applications.

name: Computer Graphics
description: 2D/3D graphics, transformations, rendering and OpenGL for BSc CSIT Semester 4.
overview: Computer Graphics covers 2D and 3D graphics fundamentals, transformations, clipping, rendering, illumination models and OpenGL programming. Creating visual content programmatically.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Search algorithms, knowledge representation, reasoning and ML intro for BSc CSIT Semester 5.
overview: Artificial Intelligence covers intelligent agent design, search algorithms, knowledge representation, reasoning, planning and introduction to machine learning. Foundations of AI systems.

name: Network Programming
description: Socket programming, protocols, concurrent servers and network application development.
overview: Network Programming covers socket API, TCP/UDP programming, concurrent server design, protocol implementation and network application development. Hands-on with real network systems.

name: Image Processing
description: Image fundamentals, transforms, enhancement, segmentation and pattern recognition.
overview: Image Processing covers digital image fundamentals, image transforms, enhancement techniques, segmentation, feature extraction and pattern recognition. Foundation for computer vision.

name: Machine Learning
description: Supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning and neural networks for BSc CSIT Semester 6.
overview: Machine Learning covers supervised learning, unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, neural networks and practical ML pipelines. Hands-on with real datasets and frameworks.

name: DevOps & Cloud Computing
description: CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/Azure and infrastructure as code for BSc CSIT Semester 6.
overview: DevOps & Cloud Computing covers CI/CD pipelines, containerization, orchestration, cloud platforms and infrastructure automation. Modern software deployment practices.

name: Embedded Systems
description: Microcontroller programming, RTOS, interrupts and real-time system design.
overview: Embedded Systems covers microcontroller architectures, programming, real-time operating systems, interrupt handling and embedded system design. IoT and hardware programming foundation.

name: Project Work I
description: Capstone project planning, requirements, design and initial implementation.
overview: Project Work I focuses on project planning, requirements analysis, system design and initial implementation. Students work in teams on real-world software projects.

name: Cloud Computing
description: Cloud models, virtualization, containerization, serverless and cloud security.
overview: Cloud Computing covers cloud service models, virtualization technologies, container orchestration, serverless computing, cloud security and cost optimization. Enterprise cloud architecture.

name: Project Work II
description: Final project implementation, testing, documentation and presentation.
overview: Project Work II is the continuation and completion of the capstone project. Focuses on full implementation, testing, documentation, deployment and final presentation.

name: Principles of Management
description: Management concepts, functions, theories and organizational behavior for BBA Semester 1.
overview: Principles of Management covers management fundamentals, evolution of management thought, planning, organizing, staffing, directing and controlling. Foundation for business management.

name: Microeconomics
description: Demand, supply, consumer behavior, production and market structures for BBA Semester 1.
overview: Microeconomics covers demand and supply analysis, consumer behavior, production theory, cost analysis and market structures. Economic foundation for business decisions.

name: Business English
description: Business communication, writing skills and professional English for BBA Semester 1.
overview: Business English develops professional communication skills for business contexts. Covers writing, speaking, presentation and interpersonal communication.

name: Business Statistics
description: Descriptive statistics, probability, sampling and hypothesis testing for BBA Semester 1.
overview: Business Statistics covers statistical methods for business decision-making. Includes descriptive statistics, probability, sampling distributions, estimation and hypothesis testing.
